title: Rabbi David Tawil: Understanding the Amida- “La'minim”

chapters.title: Introduction to the 19th Brakha
chapters.about: History of the Amida and the addition of the 19th blessing

chapters.title: Defining Minim and Malshim
chapters.about: Explaining heretics, slanderers, and the historical context of the Second Temple

chapters.title: The Approach of Rabbi Meir and Bruriah
chapters.about: The story in Masekhet Berakhot regarding praying for sinners to do teshuvah

chapters.title: Shmuel HaKatan and Humility

chapters.about: Maintaining the right mindset and avoiding reveling in the downfall of others

summary: Rabbi Tawil explains the history and intent behind the 19th blessing of the Amida, known as the brakha of LaMinim v'LaMalshim. He discusses why this prayer against heretics and slanderers was added to the original 18 blessings and emphasizes the importance of reciting it with the humility of Shmuel HaKatan rather than a desire for vengeance. The class highlights the balance between praying for the destruction of evil and the hope for individuals to repent.
questions: Why was a 19th blessing added to the original 18 blessings of the Amida?
How should we reconcile praying for the destruction of wicked people with the Jewish value of peace?
Why was Shmuel HaKatan chosen to compose this specific blessing?
What is the difference between praying for the destruction of sinners versus the destruction of sins?
